on_screen_text.text: Nikki Haley on women in the military being able to travel for reproductive care: “I don’t think they should be able to”
Do you believe that, you know, soldiers who are in states that have more strict abortion bans or abortion limits, should be able to travel to get the care they need?
So, I don't think they should be able to to get that part of it.

spoken_summary: An unseen person asks Nikki Haley if she believes female soldiers stationed in states with strict abortion bans should be able to travel for reproductive care. Haley responds, "So, I don't think they should be able to get that part of it."

intended_effect: To generate disapproval of Nikki Haley and portray her as being against the rights and needs of women serving in the military.
